negative_snippets:
Hotel Malviya Nagar Inn, located in Begampur, Malviya Nagar, is a decent low-budget property. They do not have parking facilities, but the hotel is suitable for an overnight stay as well as for a few hours. Room tariffs start from ₹1100.
The property is conveniently located—about a 5-minute walk from Malviya Nagar main market and roughly a 10-minute walk from Malviya Nagar Metro Station (Shivalik side gate).
